meta.title: A+B retained cruising listing audit, 6-10 of 92
meta.caveat: Original source pages, country indices and official places reviewed where available. Other seven specialty sources not exhaustively verified; no match is not proof of absence. Anonymous claims are never independently verified physical activity.

records.name: Pissouri Beach
records.location: Saved 34.64974,32.72205 exactly matches Cyprus tourism's official Pissouri Beach point; Pissouri rather than Limassol city. Specific purported cruising beach subarea not established.
records.access: Blue Flag beach, lifeguards April–October; no verified sex venue
issues: Do not confuse Pissouri main beach with distinct unverified naturist cove

records.name: Folimanka Park
records.location: Prague 2 public park beneath Nusle Bridge by Botič. Original says near public exercise area, no exact subsection verified.
records.access: Prague City Tourism confirms park, public gym, sport courts, playgrounds. Nearby Jammertal complex has its own 09:00–20:00 opening hours; not whole park hours.
issues: Nighttime claim from undated source description, not proven current
Do not claim Jammertal opening hours apply to whole park
